author: priya-raman
title: Cache currency metadata in process with a small LRU
body:
Currency decimals and symbols were read from the reference table for every row. There are about 180 currencies, so a `functools.lru_cache(maxsize=256)` holds all of them.

The data never changes inside a deploy, so there is nothing to invalidate. Import time on the sample file drops from 41 s to 29 s.
